meta.note: Single source of truth. Edit this file, then run: python3 docs/redesign/tools/build-tokens.py

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Brand hue 1. Gradient start, path-eyebrow prefix and focus ring on night surfaces. Never as small text on cream (2.9:1): use accent-ink there.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Brand hue 2. Gradient middle, timeline dots, principle numbers on cream (4.6:1). Not for small text on night (3.7:1).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand hue 3. Gradient end, terminal prompts, behind-panel keys, timeline dates on night (8.6:1).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: System 'ok' voice: terminal success lines and links, commit types, client role badge. Night surfaces only.

tokens.name: btn-start
tokens.usage: Primary button gradient, start. Darker than magenta so white label text holds 5:1.

tokens.name: btn-mid
tokens.usage: Primary button gradient, middle (white text 6.5:1).

tokens.name: btn-end
tokens.usage: Primary button gradient, end (white text 5.2:1).

tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Page ground for night sections, hero and contact.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Raised night surface: testimonials, modal, behind panel, terminal.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Third night step: menu button, chips, shot browser bar.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Ground for cream sections (Work, Behind the code).

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Project card face on cream sections.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Text on cream-100 and cream-50 (15.9:1). Also the dark tile and lead strip fill on cream.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Long-form story text on cream-100 (9.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Muted text on cream-100 and cream-50 (6.6:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Text on night surfaces (16:1 or more).

tokens.name: lede
tokens.usage: Hero lede and case-study body copy on night surfaces (10.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: term-text
tokens.usage: Terminal output and behind-panel values on night-800 (15:1).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Muted text on night surfaces (7.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: Subtle mono metadata on night surfaces (4.8:1 or more). Was #767682 on the live theme, which failed 4.5:1.

tokens.name: employer
tokens.usage: Employer role badge text on night-800 (9.4:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section ground. Night: night-900. Cream: cream-100.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that sit on surface.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, section intros, nav links on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Mono metadata: hashes, dates, hints, browser-bar URLs.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text such as the ~/elisa prefix in path eyebrows. Cream value is darker to hold 5.6:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px :focus-visible outline, offset 3px. 6:1 on night, 4.6:1 on cream.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders on surface.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Ghost button borders, input borders, terminal border.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral tag and filter-track fill.

tokens.name: tag-built-fg
tokens.usage: 'Built' tag text on cream-50 (8.6:1).

tokens.name: tag-built-bg
tokens.usage: 'Built' tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-solved-fg
tokens.usage: 'Solved' tag text on cream-50 (6.8:1).

tokens.name: tag-solved-bg
tokens.usage: 'Solved' tag fill.

tokens.name: shot-bar
tokens.usage: Browser-frame bar above project screenshots.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop.

styles.name: hero-h1
styles.usage: Home H1 only. Fluid: clamp(44px, 7vw, 92px).

styles.name: contact-h2
styles.usage: Closing contact heading. Fluid: clamp(40px, 6.4vw, 80px).

styles.name: page-h1
styles.usage: Inner page and case-study H1. Fluid: clamp(38px, 6vw, 74px).

styles.name: section-h2
styles.usage: Section headings. Fluid: clamp(34px, 5vw, 56px).

styles.name: card-h3
styles.usage: Project and capability card titles. Fluid: clamp(21px, 2vw, 25px); lead card up to 32px.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: One or two words inside a heading, set as <em class="voice">. Inherits the heading's size.

styles.name: bridge
styles.usage: The bridge statement under the hero. Fluid: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px).

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: She'll speak up and explain why.
styles.usage: Testimonials and the pull quote. Fluid: clamp(19px, 1.8vw, 22px).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Verified stats only, with gradient text. Fluid: clamp(44px, 6vw, 72px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build them, and I solve the problems behind them.
styles.usage: Hero and page intros. Fluid: clamp(18px, 1.8vw, 21px).

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Default body copy. 16px below 760px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Australian wineries moved off older platforms onto custom Shopify stores.
styles.usage: Card summaries.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Navigation links, filter chips (14px).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and arrow links.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Hero terminal. 13px below 760px.

styles.name: behind
styles.sample: tricky: 1,000+ SKUs, four regions, no apps
styles.usage: Project behind panel, at-a-glance box.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: Section eyebrows written as a path. The ~/elisa part uses accent-ink.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Role lines, dates, hints, testimonial attributions.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label with the gradient dot. Hero title line and stat labels.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Card tags and badges.
